en.name: AeroSwift
en.subtitle: Flight and airport board
en.short_description: Track a flight, read an airport board, and save the ones you fly.
en.description:
AeroSwift is a live flight tracker built on open ADS-B data: it shows where an aircraft is right now, how high and how fast it is flying, and when it was observed taking off and landing, without an account and without noise.

WHAT IT DOES
• Search by flight number (UA1691), airline (Lufthansa) or route (SFO-JFK), or browse the live traffic around your home airport.
• Open a flight for its live position, altitude, ground speed, track and vertical rate, its operator and ICAO 24-bit address, and the departure and arrival times observed by the receiver network.
• Open any airport's board and read the arrivals and departures observed there over the last 2 to 24 hours.
• Save the flights you follow to a watchlist on the device and refresh them with one tap.
• A great-circle route diagram with the aircraft's position, and a status chip, summarise the leg at a glance. It is drawn offline, with no map tiles.

ABOUT THE DATA
All flight data is live ADS-B data from the OpenSky Network — the endpoints AeroSwift uses need no key and no sign-up. OpenSky observes where aircraft actually are. It does not publish airline schedules, gates, terminals, aircraft types or arrival estimates, so AeroSwift does not show them. When OpenSky does not report a field, the app says so instead of filling the gap. Anonymous OpenSky access covers roughly the last 24 hours.

NO ACCOUNT
There is no login, no profile, and nothing to subscribe to. Saved flights and your settings stay on the device.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
AeroSwift is a live flight tracker built on open ADS-B data: it shows where an aircraft is right now, how high and how fast it is flying, and when it was observed taking off and landing, without an account and without noise.

Intended audience:
Flight and airport board

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- OpenSky Network REST API (https://opensky-network.org/api), called anonymously over HTTPS for live aircraft positions, airport arrival/departure records and flight tracks. No key, account or user data is sent. AeroSwift has no backend of its own.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app's interface text is in English; system controls and a few common labels (Settings, Refresh, Clear, Close) follow the device language. Features and data are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry. Flight data comes from the OpenSky Network, which is credited inside the app on every flight detail screen; OpenSky's published terms make its data free for non-commercial use. The bundled airport table is derived from OurAirports (public domain). All other content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
